howToRecord: For each decision you decide, set founderSelection to an option key (or "custom" with a note), state to FOUNDER APPROVED | FOUNDER REJECTED | DEFERRED, decidedBy, decidedAt (ISO 8601). Approving one wave does not approve any other wave. A selection in the board that is not recorded in its decision store, or not committed in this file, is SELECTED — NOT RECORDED and has no authority.

experienceAuthority.rule: Customer Mobile, Customer Desktop/Tablet and Administration are separate experience authorities sharing business records, not UI.

approvals.meaning: Apply M1A+M2+M3 to production after staging evidence

evidenceItems.subject: Service-role key present in FS and SITE00 production

decisions.subject: Approve the P0A database containment migration

options.label: Approve narrowly scoped migration with prepared rollback, rehearsed on a Supabase branch, SITE00 smoke-tested
Defer

decisions.proposedDisposition: Split into two approvals: A1a rehearse M1A+M2+M3 on staging; A1b apply the same files to production after the staging evidence pack. M1B stays blocked (U-01).

decisions.subject: Staging environment for signed-in verification

options.label: Supabase branch + Stripe test mode + seeded test accounts (customer standard/premium, admin, founder)
Separate staging project

decisions.proposedDisposition: Recommend option: separate staging Supabase project + Vercel Preview on a staging domain + Stripe test mode (doc 13). Founder chooses once the operator confirms the Supabase plan tier, production host and Stripe test keys.

decisions.subject: SITE00 shares the Supabase project

options.label: Coordinate every FS migration with a SITE00 impact check now; plan SITE00 move to its own project
Coordinate only

decisions.proposedDisposition: Engineering default: every FS migration gets a shared-database impact review (doc 11); FS never alters SITE00-owned objects; SITE00 owner notified and runs the SITE00/JURNL smoke (doc 11 §4). Founder acknowledges, no choice required.

decisions.subject: Build-A-Wig checkout until server pricing exists

options.label: Concierge-confirmed custom quote: Atelier and bag stay open; custom lines become "Request my custom quote" → admin sends consult offer → customer pays the server-held quoted amount
Block card checkout for custom lines and route to "Book a consultation"
Keep current behaviour

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder chooses the interim BAW path. Recommendation unchanged (option 1: Concierge-confirmed custom quote), with the corrected evidence that BAW is currently undercharged, not blocked.

decisions.subject: Non-Stripe CONFIRM ORDER on /checkout/upgrade

options.label: Disable in production (keep for non-production demo builds only)
Keep

decisions.proposedDisposition: Engineering default: remove the non-Stripe CONFIRM ORDER membership path from production (dev-only flag).

decisions.subject: Membership cancellation and saved payment methods

options.label: Stripe Customer Portal for cancel/plan/payment methods
In-app cancel (cancel_at_period_end) + Stripe Elements for cards

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder chooses portal vs in-app cancel. Stopping raw card inputs on /account/payment is an engineering default. Portal must be configured for cancel-at-period-end only so it cannot contradict the established upgrade/downgrade policy.

decisions.subject: Mock / demo / seed data in production

options.label: Quarantine all mock paths behind ?demo=1 on non-production hosts; founder "view as client" shows real data
Keep founder-only mocks

decisions.proposedDisposition: Engineering default (per this brief: accurate empty states over fabricated records): quarantine all mocks from customers and admins. Founder decides only whether the founder's own production account keeps founder-only demo data.

decisions.subject: Slay Ticket purchases

options.label: Pause pack purchases until webhook-only crediting ships (in S0B-2)
Ship webhook crediting first, then re-enable

decisions.proposedDisposition: Engineering default: pause Slay Ticket pack purchases until webhook-only crediting exists; balances and spending stay.

decisions.subject: Booking autopay final payments

options.label: Keep autopay off until server-sourced IDs and amounts ship; collect final balances manually meanwhile
Fix and enable in the same sprint

decisions.proposedDisposition: Engineering default: keep autopay dormant until card/amount are resolved server-side; do not fix the cron first. Deposit wording/collection preference recorded as U-16 for the founder.

decisions.subject: Remediation for customers affected by money defects

options.label: Check Stripe for any 4-pack analysis or Slay Ticket or BAW payments; refund or grant manually with audit
No action

decisions.proposedDisposition: Blocked: run read-only Stripe queries (4-pack payments, billed-after-cancel, Slay Ticket/BAW charges). Database side already known: 0 grants, 0 orders, 0 subscriptions (live 2026-10-25).

decisions.subject: /tools/hairstyle-analysis harness

options.label: Admin-only; customers redirect to MY HAIR › ANALYSES
Keep

decisions.proposedDisposition: Engineering default: /tools/hairstyle-analysis becomes admin-only (credit-consuming test harness); fix the design-dna canon list accordingly.

decisions.subject: Fabricated Slay Cam stats and testimonials

options.label: Remove stats; label posts as curated editorial until real submissions exist
Keep

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder approves the public Slay Cam copy. Recommendation: remove the fabricated stats and named testimonials; show an accurate empty state until real approved submissions exist.

decisions.subject: Approve the customer page tree (10 families, 21 routed pages, 3 new)

options.label: Approve as proposed
Approve with amendments (note them)

decisions.proposedDisposition: Re-scoped as the MOBILE account tree only (10 families, 21 URLs). Desktop/tablet access to the same capabilities is decided separately (XD-1). No universal responsive shell.

decisions.subject: Approve the admin page tree (15 families, 24 routed pages, 5 new, 10 folded)

options.label: Approve as proposed
Approve with amendments

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder approves per page (Admin Alignment Protocol: every admin page finalized unless named). Present the 5 new pages and 10 folds as separate approvals.

decisions.subject: Admin roles and money authority

options.label: admin_roles: FOUNDER / ADMIN (STAFF later); refunds and adjustments above a threshold need FOUNDER
Everyone on the allow-list can do everything

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder sets the admin role model and money-action thresholds.

decisions.subject: Canonical order status vocabulary and stage SLAs

options.label: pending_payment → paid → awaiting_form → confirmed → in_production (sourcing, constructing, cleansing, customizing, finalizing) → shipped → delivered; + canceled, refunded, issue; digital: paid → processing → complete; founder supplies SLA days per stage
Founder-specified list

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder sets the canonical physical-order stage list and SLA days. Established inputs: custom processing windows (Terms 2026-05-27), consult stages PLACED/PROCESSING/COMPLETE, digital 3-stage gift cards.

decisions.subject: Welcome credits

options.label: Founder confirms amounts, once-per-tier vs per-term, and whether premium and spend-tier credits stack

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder sets premium welcome amounts and stacking. Established: spend-tier welcome is once per new tier.

decisions.subject: Points expiry

options.label: Points never expire (retire points_expiring email)
Expire after N months inactivity
Fixed period from earn date

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder decides whether and how points expire.

decisions.subject: Affiliate rewards and caps

options.label: Confirm copy values as canonical; caps per copy; show sub-caps; no multipliers; define Featured Creator later
Founder edits values

decisions.proposedDisposition: Established: copy values 400/600/600, 5,000 per unit per 6 months, Featured Creator up to 1,500. Founder decides only: hidden 2+2 sub-cap, multipliers, Featured Creator award process.

decisions.subject: Points for review content

options.label: Founder sets review-content points (or none)

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder decides points for review content.

decisions.subject: Referral program rules

options.label: Confirm $20/$20; credit when the referred order is delivered; reverse on refund/cancel; no stacking with +100 earn task
Confirm $20/$20 at confirmation (current)
Different amounts

decisions.proposedDisposition: Established: $20 off friend / $20 digital cash referrer. Founder decides timing, activation, reversal, stacking. Not implemented automatically.

decisions.subject: Undefined perks

options.label: Define each (contents, trigger, fulfilment) or remove its copy

decisions.proposedDisposition: Established: tier welcome bonuses 250/500/1,000 + vouchers (founder copy). Founder defines contents/trigger/fulfilment of the named-only perks.

decisions.subject: Anniversary semantics

options.label: Once per completed term, including renewals
Once per membership year
First term only

decisions.proposedDisposition: Established: 500/1,000/1,500 by 3/6/12 months, amounts internal. Founder decides renewal re-trigger semantics.

decisions.subject: "Hair Bestie Bonus"

options.label: Drop the term
Define amount, trigger, eligibility

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder: drop the term "Hair Bestie Bonus" or define it.

decisions.subject: Birthday gift

options.label: Premium only; claim window around birthday; fulfilled via ledger
Premium + affiliates

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder sets birthday gift eligibility, claim window and fulfilment.

options.label: Subscribers + anyone who buys credits may use purchased credits; BLACK gets no free monthly; bonus credit = one paid-credit grant
Subscribers only; disable purchase for others
Also give BLACK the monthly free analysis

decisions.proposedDisposition: Established: 1 free per month for 3/6/12-month members; paid 1=$20, 4=$60. Founder decides non-subscriber use, BLACK spend tier, bonus-credit grant path.

decisions.subject: MY HAIR as its own family (profile, analyses, builds)

options.label: Own family /account/hair with 3 tabs + analysis detail route
Split: analyses under Rewards, builds under Wishlist

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder decides MY HAIR as a MOBILE family. Desktop/tablet already has a Penthouse Analysis Lab room; its account-history presentation belongs to XD-1.

decisions.subject: Concierge scope

options.label: Premium-only page: messages (with replies), offers, orders-in-progress links, gifts; tracking → order detail
Keep as is

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder decides Concierge contents. Established: Concierge is premium-only (code conflicts: route open to non-premium).

decisions.subject: Support for all members (MY REQUESTS + replies)

options.label: support_requests threads for everyone; premium keeps priority routing
Premium-only replies

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder decides two-way support for all members. Established: priority messages are a 6/12-month perk.

decisions.subject: Navigation labels (creative)

options.label: Use proposed labels
Founder wording (note it)

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder approves navigation labels (mobile).

Keep cards, remove fake numbers

decisions.proposedDisposition: Removing fabricated numbers is an engineering default (S0B-2 #8, no layout change). Founder decides which queues/metrics the Command Center shows.

decisions.subject: Selfie consent, retention and deletion

options.label: Founder-approved consent text; private storage; retention N days (founder sets); delete on request and account deletion

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder (with counsel) approves selfie consent wording, retention and deletion.

options.label: Founder supplies wording (or approves a drafted version reviewed by counsel)

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder (with counsel) approves UGC consent and usage-rights wording.

decisions.subject: Slay MVP selection and reward

options.label: Admin picks MVP per period; reward defined by founder
No MVP

decisions.subject: Lounge comment moderation

Pre-moderate all comments

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder sets community moderation policy and report threshold.

Persistent side rail ≥1024px

Keep 448 everywhere

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder approves any admin width change.

decisions.proposedDisposition: Mobile-only: status panels on the mobile /account hub and MY HAIR visuals. The Penthouse Suite keeps its own design.

Keep dark (intentional studio look)

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder decides Trend Desk / PSA Broadcast visual treatment.

Keep placeholder

Everything through S6 verified

Approve all at once
Defer

options.label: Default to 3-month privileges
Keep 12-month

decisions.proposedDisposition: Engineering default: an unknown tier fails closed (least privilege), never defaults to 12-month privileges.

decisions.subject: Build-A-Wig price catalogue ownership

options.label: Code-defined single catalogue with an admin read view; changes by release
Admin-editable catalogue table (founder approves price changes)

decisions.proposedDisposition: Engineering default: one code-defined BAW catalogue used by client and server (S1B). An admin price editor would be a later product decision.

decisions.subject: Where Slay Challenge lives

options.label: REWARDS › SLAY CHALLENGE tab
Stay in Concierge

decisions.proposedDisposition: Slay Challenge (and Quests) stay in Concierge. V2 recommendation to move them to Rewards is withdrawn; a move would be a founder reversal.

options.label: Keep the Penthouse redirect, but it must read /api/account/overview so numbers match
Pause redirect until desktop phase; centred 720px account column

decisions.proposedDisposition: ≥768px /account → /desktop/account (Penthouse Suite) stays. The "pause redirect / 720px column" options are withdrawn. Data parity (one server source) is engineering.

decisions.subject: Mobile Mansion /mobile/* placeholder pages

options.label: Keep unlinked and out of the account tree until a dedicated creative sprint
Remove routes
Make it the mobile home now

decisions.proposedDisposition: Mobile Mansion /mobile/* stays a foundation-only, unlinked prototype. Guarding routes and the Playfair token are engineering hygiene.

decisions.subject: Studio OS boundary

options.label: Single STUDIO link in the admin menu; no Studio/SITE00 modules in FS admin
Keep cards

decisions.proposedDisposition: Studio Command Center and Headquarters cards stay on the FS admin dashboard until Command Center moves to its own routes. V2 option 1 withdrawn.

decisions.subject: Slay Challenge requirement and reveal model

options.label: Keep 4 tiers; reveal phase = share of the tier's own required count (phase 2 at ≥75%, phase 3 at 100%)
Adopt 3 requirements per reward (rewrite tiers to 3 tasks)
Other (founder specifies)

decisions.proposedDisposition: 4 tiers (5/7, 4/7, 5/9, 6/9), choose 1 of 2, 3 phases with phase 2 at 75%, no new art. Code conflicts (totalRequirements=3; 67%) are engineering fixes.

decisions.subject: Benefit eligibility conflicts

options.label: Follow the published benefit list (special offers 12; challenges all premium; live tracking 3+)
Follow current code gates; update copy

decisions.proposedDisposition: Challenges for all premium; special offers 12-month only; live order tracking from 3 months. Code conflicts (psaFeatureGates.ts:14-16, concierge/page.tsx:1727) are engineering fixes.

decisions.subject: Purchase points formula

options.label: Eligible net × multiplier (checkout rule) everywhere
Order total 1:1

decisions.proposedDisposition: Multipliers apply to eligible purchases (eligible net × multiplier; 12-month 2X overrides). Base rate 1 point/$1 exists only in code: one-line founder confirmation optional.

decisions.subject: Edit-from-cart gate

options.label: Sign-in only (canon); premium-only options stay gated
Premium only

decisions.proposedDisposition: Edit-from-cart is premium-only (latest founder directive). V2 option 1 withdrawn; CORE.md:50 is stale (doc fix).

decisions.subject: Asynchronous deliverables (PSA picks, consult add-on)

options.label: Store and deliver automatically (PSA picks immediately; consult add-on generated and reviewed by admin before release within 24h)
Remove the 24h promise / add-on until built

decisions.proposedDisposition: PSA hair analysis keeps the 24-hour delivery promise; engineering builds the delivery. V2 options that removed or replaced the promise are withdrawn.

decisions.subject: Public review display

options.label: Show approved, consented reviews on product pages and /brand/reviews
Keep private

decisions.proposedDisposition: Reviews will be shown publicly on PDPs and /brand/reviews; publication waits on F2 consent.

decisions.subject: Account desktop column widths

options.label: Centred 720px (forms) / 960px (lists) column on marble; optional side rail later
Founder-specified widths

decisions.proposedDisposition: Moot: ≥768px customers are in the desktop/tablet experience. No 720/960 widened mobile column. Residual question moved to XD-1.

decisions.subject: Slay Quests show hardcoded progress

options.label: Show real progress or an accurate empty state
Hide quests until real

decisions.proposedDisposition: No fabricated progress (this brief: accurate empty states over fabricated records). Engineering chooses empty state vs hide by data availability.

decisions.subject: Slay Challenge selection window and server-side reward options

options.label: Server picks the 2 options per user per tier; selection open for the cycle
Keep a last-3-days selection window

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder decides the selection window. Moving option generation to the server is an engineering default (cross-experience consistency).

decisions.subject: Vouchers wiped for real customers; which events issue vouchers

options.label: Stop the wipe now; define issuance events under D3/D9

decisions.proposedDisposition: Engineering default: stop the wipe (defect). Issuance events are decided inside D3/D9. Voucher validity (6 months from redemption) is established founder copy.

decisions.subject: How desktop/tablet customers reach account capabilities that have no desktop presentation today

options.label: Keep the hand-off to mobile pages as an explicit INTERIM, and design desktop/tablet presentations capability by capability in the Tower language (each approved separately)
Design desktop/tablet presentations for all hand-off capabilities before any further account work
Accept mobile pages as the permanent desktop/tablet presentation for these capabilities

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder decides. Recommendation option 1, capability order: orders/order detail, rewards/membership, settings.

decisions.subject: Tablet (768–1023px) experience authority

options.label: Tablet = desktop/tablet experience everywhere (one 768px threshold)
Tablet = mobile everywhere (one 1024px threshold)
Keep the current split

decisions.proposedDisposition: Founder decides. Recommendation option 1 (matches the latest tablet directives).

decisions.subject: Is the desktop/tablet Tower live on the production domain?

options.label: Confirm desktop/tablet is live (current behaviour)
Gate desktop to staging/preview until launch

decisions.proposedDisposition: Blocked by evidence: which domain serves production (doc 12 A5) and what production visitors at ≥1024px see today.
